about-text-1: Since 2022, I have been working as a freelance translator and editor – with a great passion for language, stories, and good style. I offer editing and proofreading services, translate books from English to German, and take on translation editing projects to bring texts to life linguistically and stylistically. My focus areas include Romance, Fantasy, Thriller, and Sci-Fi (including their sub-genres).
about-text-2: Before I became self-employed in September 2022, I studied American Studies, English Literature and German Studies at the TU Dortmund. This combination has deepened my love for languages and literature – and forms the basis of my work today: texts that are not only correct but also vibrant, clear, and authentic.
about-text-3: If you are working on your first novel, want to have your book translated, or simply looking for someone who will accompany your text with passion and a keen sense for language – then you are in the right place.
service-editing-text: In editing, I give your text the final polish: I review style, expression, and structure. I help make sure your story flows smoothly, the style feels well-rounded, and every scene conveys exactly the emotion you intend.
service-proofreading-text: Proofreading focuses on linguistic accuracy: I take care of spelling, grammar, punctuation, and the small details that make all the difference – while your text stays true to itself and keeps your voice.
service-translation-text: When translating from English into German, I carry your story over and make sure it reads naturally, vividly, and with stylistic consistency while preserving the intention of your original – as if it had been written in German from the very beginning.
service-translation-editing-text: Already translated? In translation editing, I revise existing translations so they sound polished, fluent, and authentic without changing the original style. In the end, your text reads like a true original – just in German.
